name: AIIMS NORCET Nursing Officer Practice Mock - Practice Test 2
courseName: AIIMS NORCET Nursing Officer Practice Mock

questions.question: What is the normal pulse rate of a healthy adult?
questions.hint: The normal range of adult heart beats is 60 to 100 beats per minute.

questions.question: Which route of drug administration provides the fastest absorption?
questions.hint: IV delivery injects drugs directly into systemic circulation.

questions.question: The infection acquired by a patient during hospital stay is called:
questions.hint: Hospital-acquired infections are referred to as nosocomial.

questions.question: What is the size of an IV cannula used for blood transfusion in adults?
questions.hint: A larger bore (18 Gauge) is required to prevent hemolysis during rapid blood infusions.

questions.question: Which position is recommended for a patient who is short of breath?
questions.hint: Fowler's (semi-sitting) allows maximal lung chest expansion.

questions.question: What is the primary cause of bedsores (decubitus ulcers)?
questions.hint: Ischemia due to local tissue compression cuts off local circulation.

questions.question: What is the normal pH of arterial blood?
questions.hint: Tight blood pH buffers must remain within 7.35 to 7.45 for metabolic enzymes.

questions.question: The instrument used to check the lungs and heart sounds is:
questions.hint: A stethoscope amplifies internal body acoustic sounds.

questions.question: Which electrolyte imbalance is majorly associated with cardiac arrhythmias?
questions.hint: Potassium drives cardiac cell repolarization; hyper/hypokalemia causes dysrhythmias.

questions.question: The first milk produced by the mother after childbirth is called:
questions.hint: Colostrum is thick, yellowish, and rich in maternal immunoglobulins.

questions.question: Which vitamin deficiency causes night blindness?
questions.hint: Vitamin A (retinol) is required to form visual purple rhodopsin.

questions.question: The method used to open the airway of a suspected spinal injury patient is:
questions.hint: Jaw-thrust opens the airway without hyperextending the cervical neck.

questions.question: Which hormone increases water reabsorption in the kidneys?
questions.hint: ADH inserts aquaporins in collecting ducts to retain blood water.

questions.question: What is the color code of a bio-medical waste bag for discarding anatomical waste?
questions.hint: Placenta, organs, and tissue waste go in yellow incinerator bags.

questions.question: What is the standard sterilization temperature and pressure in an autoclave?
questions.hint: Pressurized steam reaches 121°C to kill heat-resistant bacterial spores.
